A tiny introduction to otome games

A moment,
unwritten.

One evening. Three choices. A small shift in how a story feels.

Choose a character and step into a short, branching romantic scene.

No timer. No wrong answers. Choose the response that feels most like you.

After the rain / 01
After the rain

A bookshop is closing. Rain has softened the city outside. For a moment, neither of you has anywhere else to be.

You just played a miniature otome scene.

01 / A character to connect withThe story centres on a developing romantic connection and a distinctive fictional personality.
02 / Choices within a scriptYou choose from authored dialogue options. Each selection reveals a different response.
03 / A branching relationshipYour choices steer the tone and ending. A longer game may develop character routes and affection systems.

This is the boundary explored in the thesis: external AI lets players move beyond preset options and write their own replies.

An illustrative, fan-made micro-story for a research portfolio. All dialogue and scenarios in this demo are newly written, not game excerpts, interview quotations or AI-generated live responses. Character artwork © Papergames / Infold Games · Official gallery.
